Semester Exchange Program
The Semester Exchange Program attracts students from our partner universities who wish to study at SJTU for one or two semesters. To be an exchange student, candidates must be officially nominated by their home university.​
Program coordinator from partner universities will nominate students in the nomination system. Nominees will receive an application link through which they can complete the online applications.​
Soft reminder: Please do not use Gmail & Hotmail as your nomination and sign-in email. IE and Chrome are recommenced for online application.​
Fact Sheet 2026-2027
1. SEMESTER DATES
FALL Semester
:
September 2026 – January 2027
SPRING Semester
:
February 2027 – July 2027
The
registration date
is generally the Friday before the semester begins.
The
last two weeks
are exam weeks, and the exam schedule will depend on the specific courses.
Please note that the
SJTU Global College
(
UM-SJTU Joint Institute
)
has its own
Academic Calendar
2. NOMINATION & APPLICATION
2.1 Eligibility
√ A minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale.
√ HSK 5 at least for attending the Chinese Taught Course (Original test certificate required).
√ IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 90 for attending English Taught Courses (Original test certificate not required. No requirement for native speakers).
√ Must be a full-time, matriculated student in one of SJTU's exchange partner institutions.
√ Have completed at least two semesters of study at home university to commencing the exchange period.
√ Non-Chinese citizen.
2.2 Nomination & Application Procedure
A login password to the Online Application Portal has been provided to the exchange coordinators. The nomination link is：http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn/partner/c.asp?action=partner_sign
Exchange coordinators shall
fill in nominees' information
accordingly.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials, it is essential that the
Exchange coordinators
verifies the nominee's information at the time of nomination,
especially the student's first and last names
, which must match exactly as they appear on the passport, as name information cannot be changed later.
Upon successful nomination, students will receive a link to the Online Application Portal via email.
Nominated students should log in to the system and apply before the application deadline. The application guide can click
here
.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials,
students
should confirm that they have completely
filled out all information on the application form
, such as passport number, date of birth, and so on.
Once the application is approved, the students will get the results via email.
2.3 Documents for application
√ Bio-page of passport
*Please ensure your passport is valid for at least 6 months from the commencement of your exchange at SJTU.
√ Resume
√ Latest transcript from the home university
√ A recommendation or nomination letter from the home university
√ Study plan
*There is no fixed template. Students can fill in the courses they are interested in. The application form will be submitted to the school for review. It is recommended that students list courses from the respective school in their study plan. The study plan is for the reference of the reviewing faculty and does not represent the final courses available for selection. Students must be flexible in their course choices, which will be based on the notifications from each school.
√ Passport-size photo
√ Language proficiency certificate (if applicable)
2.4 Application Deadline
Fall (September to January): March 30
Spring (February to June): Oct 30
3. PROGRAMS & COURSES
More than 30 schools/departme
nts at SJTU which are open to university-level exchange students to choose.
Exchange students coming to our university need to be admitted by a specific school. Once admitted,
they can only choose courses from that school
. If they wish to select courses from another school, they must obtain prior approval from the relevant faculty.
Due to limitations in the language of instruction and course capacity at our university, we need the students to be flexible in their course selection.
For the most updated information about majors and courses, please consult with the
School / Department
. Course selection is subject to the school's notification.
3.1 Restricted Programs and Courses
All courses from the
School of Medicine and Shanghai Advanced Institute of Finance
are not available to university-level exchange students.
School of Computer Science and Technology,
The number of vacancies for these courses is highly limited due to the current capacity issue.
The application for
Antai College of Economics and Management
is highly competitive, and applicants must have an academic background in economics and management-related disciplines.
Some schools, such as the
School of International and Public Affairs/KoGuan Law School etc
., do not offer undergraduate courses taught in English.If you choose these schools, you can select the English-taught graduate programs offered by the school.
Not all graduate courses are available to undergraduate exchange students, and vice versa.
3.2 Schools
You can click
here
to view information about each college. The college information will be gradually updated in the modules below.
SJTU Global College
SJTU Global College
offers three engineering majors:
Mechanical Engineering (ME)
,
Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE)
,
Materials Science and Engineering (MSE)
.
Please note that the Joint Institute has its own
Academic Calendar
and
course selection system
.
If you wish to attend courses at the
SJTU Global College
, please select
USJTU Global College
as your first preference in the application form. Details can be found
HERE
. Courses are available for selection
only
by students of this college.
Course selection at the
SJTU Global College
is subject to notifications from the
SJTU Global College
.
SJTU-ParisTech Elite Institute of Technology
SPEIT offers three engineering majors:
Information Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Energy and Power Engineering
. For more detailed information, please visit the
website
.
If you are keen on enrolling in courses at SPEIT, please select
SPEIT
as your first preference in the application form.Courses are available for selection
only
by students of this college.You can find a preliminary course list
HERE
.
School of Humanities-Intensive Chinese Language Program
This program is a
Chinese language learning program
that will provide different levels of Chinese language classes based on your proficiency. The courses include
listening, reading, writing, and speaking
. The classes are held at the
Xuhui campus
.
Please note that the School of Humanities
has its own
course selection system
for the Intensive Chinese Language program.
Course selection for the Internsive Chinese Language Program is subject to notifications from the School of Humanities.
School of Mechanical Engineering
The history of the School of Mechanical Engineering (ME) of Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) dates back to 1913. Over the past century, the school has cultivated tens of thousands of graduates who made significant contributions to technological development and economic growth in the world, such as scientists, engineers, educators, statesmen and entrepreneurs. In the new century, the school adopted a vision of a world-class engineering school that offers the best learning experience for its students, the most rewarding working environment for its faculty and staff as well as the most effective service to the industry and society.
Schedule of
Postgraduate Courses
offered in English for
2025 Fall Semester
https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/innotice/7571.html， for
2026 Spring Semester
https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/innotice/7626.html
The
syllabus for graduate courses
can be found here: https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/coursesInfo.html
Antai College of Economics and Management (ACEM)
There are no major restrictions for
undergraduate exchange students
. Undergraduate exchange students are eligible to choose from all English-taught undergraduate courses offered during the semester. If your Chinese proficiency meets the required level (native speaker proficiency or at least HSK 5 equivalent), you may also select from the available Chinese-taught courses, based on your individual language abilities.
Graduate exchange students
are eligible to select courses from the
Master of International Business (MIB)
program offered during the semester. (This applies only to regular graduate exchange students and does not apply to MBA exchange students, which is operated separately.)
MBA courses are only available for school level MBA exchange students.
More information about courses can be found on https://mba.sjtu.edu.cn/en/academics/academic-calendar.html
Courses are available for selection
only
by students of this college.
School of Materials Science and Engineering (SMSE)
Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) is pioneering in setting up the discipline of Materials Science and Engineering in China, which has been composed of departments of materials science and engineering since 1997 and among which the heat treatment major was set up in 1952. The discipline of 'Materials Science and Engineering' is one of the first national first-degree subjects and has been consistently ranked top 1‰ in ESI. .
Course information can be found here
https://en.smse.sjtu.edu.cn/academics/Courses
School of Agriculture and Biology
School of Agriculture and Biology offers four majors:
Plant Science, Animal Science, Resources and Environment, and Food Science and Engineering
.
School of Agriculture and Biology has been adhering to be a high-level modern agriculture-oriented, actively exploring innovations and demand-driven agricultural science school.
School of Aeronautics and Astronautics
SAA welcomes exchange students to apply for our undergraduate program in
Aeronautics
and
Astronautics Engineering
and graduate program in
Mechanical Engineering
. Detailed course listings for these programs are available on our official website:
https://www.aero.sjtu.edu.cn/en/academics/courses.
School of Life Sciences and Biotechnology
As a leading institution in life sciences and biotechnology education and research, School of Life Sciences and Biotechnology (SLSB) boasts two first-level disciplines, encompassing a wide range of sub-disciplines including
Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Genetics, Microbiology, Developmental Biology, Cell Biology, Bioinformatics, and Bioengineering
. With a vibrant academic community comprising over 200 undergraduates, 300 master's students, and 600 doctoral candidates, SLSB offers a dynamic and collaborative learning environment. Our sub-disciplines in Biology and Biochemistry, Molecular Biology and Genetics rank among the top 1‰ globally in ESI International Rankings, attesting to the excellence of our research and education.
Only English courses at the graduate level are available for selection, and undergraduate exchange students can choose from these courses, which include:Structural Bioinformatics(Spring),Biosafety(Spring),Cell and Developmental Biology(Fall),Genetics and Development(Fall),Microbial Infection and Immunity(Fall),Molecular Signal Transduction(Fall),Synthetic Biology(Fall),Bioprocess Engineering(Fall),Bioprocess and Bioproduct Engineering(Fall),Modern Biotechnology(Fall),Anaerobic Biotechnology and Engineering(Fall)
China-UK Low Carbon College
The Low Carbon College (LCC) is a joint initiative between Shanghai Jiao Tong University and the University of Edinburgh, dedicated to advancing research and education in low-carbon fields. As the first college in China to pioneer low-carbon research and education, LCC offers three master’s programs:
Low Carbon Environment, Low Carbon Energy, and Hydrogen Energy & Energy Storage.
Undergraduate exchange students are also welcome to select courses from these programs. All courses are taught in English.For more details, please visit our website:
https://lcc.sjtu.edu.cn/En
.
School of Media and Communication
The School of Media and Communication boasts a high degree of internationalization, with over 200 international graduate students enrolled throughout the year, hailing from more than 50 countries around the globe, including world-renowned universities.
Our institution is structured into three departments:
Journalism & Communication, Film & Television, and Cultural Industry Management
. Each department offers a range of programs at the bachelor, master, and doctoral levels, catering to diverse academic interests and career aspirations.
In addition to undergraduate and graduate programs in Chinese, we also offer
fully English-taught graduate programs including M.A. in Journalism and Communication
and Ph.D. in Journalism and Communication with a focus on New Media Studies, Exchange students are free to select courses from the corresponding programs for their studies.
School of Biomedical Engineering
BME-SJTU offers four engineering majors:
Biology，Biomedical Engineering，Electrical Engineering，Biology and Medicine
.Please find more information within official website:
https://en.bme.sjtu.edu.cn/
.
If you want to know more information about the courses, please contact
mmxie@sjtu.edu.cn
Global Institute of Future Technology
The institute is named the Global Institute of Future Technology (GIFT), symbolizing a dedicated faculty cultivating gifted individuals with care and vision. GIFT is committed to breaking boundaries in learning, disciplines, and institutions, and to building a globally influential, China-rooted model of industry education integration. Its mission is to nurture strategic, globally minded leaders for future industries. The institute collaborates closely with SJTU’s traditional strengths in science, engineering, biomedical sciences, and management, working to establish large-scale, interdisciplinary research centers, and promoting an innovative model to accelerate technology commercialization.
For more information, please visit our official website:
https://gift.sjtu.edu.cn/en/
Sustainable Energy and Health Science and Technology for the undergraduate study and Graduate programs are targeted at applicants from a variety of disciplines, including Mechanical Engineering, Control Science and Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Design and Automation, Power Engineering, Automation, Mechanics, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology, etc.
All courses taught in GIFT are in English. If you want to know more about courses, please contact with:
kirstenchen@sjtu.edu.cn
4. PREPARATION BEFORE ARRIVAL
All electronic materials, including admission letters and visa forms, will be sent to the student's email address directly. We only provide electronic copies of the admission materials, and the paper version of the admission notice can be collected when the student registers for enrollment.
4.1 Visa application
All students are required to apply for a
Student Visa (X visa)
at the Chinese Embassy or Consulate in your country with their passport, admission notice and visa application for study in China. Please contact the local Embassy or Consulate for more information.
Work permit: NO
4.2 Insurance
All exchange students should purchase the Group Comprehensive Insurance in Mainland China.

4.3 Accommodation
Due to the limited number of dormitories, on-campus accommodation is not guaranteed. Accommodation booking notifications will be sent along with the admission materials.
In case of failure to reserve an on-campus room, or if you plan to live off-campus, the average rent for one-room lodging in the campus neighborhood is 3,000 RMB per month for the Minhang Campus and 5,000 RMB per month for the Xuhui Campus.
Both the Xuhui and Minhang campuses provide on-campus accommodation options.
Due to limited capacity, the availability of on-campus accommodation is not guaranteed.
Detailed information on the on-campus accommodation is provided as follows：
About Apartment Buildings for International Students:

a. Building 1 and Building 2 of Nanyang Bei Yuan (南洋北苑) is located at No. 360, Zhangjiali Road, Minhang District, Shanghai. Two types of rooms are available: a single room with an independent toilet and a single room with a shared toilet. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, and basic furniture. 交大迎来2026年秋季学期港澳台交换生
2026年09月14日
9月11日，上海交通大学迎来40余名来自港澳台高校的交换生，开启本学期的交流学习之旅。当日下午，学校举办新生见面会，帮助他们快速了解交大、融入校园生活。
见面会上，港澳台办公室主任尹海涛代表学校致欢迎词。他表示，学生是学校的希望、国家的未来，交大各相关部门将全力为交换生做好服务保障。他勉励同学们珍惜在交大宝贵的学习时光，积极拓展自己的边界，多参与学术交流与校园文化活动，收获知识与友谊。
港澳台办公室张宏江老师就日常管理、校园生活指南等资讯进行全面解读，帮助同学们扫除初来乍到的疑惑。随后，学生社团“和合华韵社”社长庄淮宇同学生动介绍了社团特色活动与招新情况，邀请同学们在课余时间体验中华传统文化与交大学子的青春活力。
自动化与感知学院、凯原法学院、外国语学院等接收交换生院系的负责老师也出席了本次见面会，与同学们进行了亲切交流，并就本学期的专业学习安排与注意事项进行了说明。
作者：
港澳台办
供稿单位：
国际合作与交流处
责任编辑：
庄恩嘉

Semester Exchange Program
The Semester Exchange Program attracts students from our partner universities who wish to study at SJTU for one or two semesters. To be an exchange student, candidates must be officially nominated by their home university.​
Program coordinator from partner universities will nominate students in the nomination system. Nominees will receive an application link through which they can complete the online applications.​
Soft reminder: Please do not use Gmail & Hotmail as your nomination and sign-in email. IE and Chrome are recommenced for online application.​
Fact Sheet 2026-2027
1. SEMESTER DATES
FALL Semester
:
September 2026 – January 2027
SPRING Semester
:
February 2027 – July 2027
The
registration date
is generally the Friday before the semester begins.
The
last two weeks
are exam weeks, and the exam schedule will depend on the specific courses.
Please note that the
SJTU Global College
(
UM-SJTU Joint Institute
)
has its own
Academic Calendar
2. NOMINATION & APPLICATION
2.1 Eligibility
√ A minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale.
√ HSK 5 at least for attending the Chinese Taught Course (Original test certificate required).
√ IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 90 for attending English Taught Courses (Original test certificate not required. No requirement for native speakers).
√ Must be a full-time, matriculated student in one of SJTU's exchange partner institutions.
√ Have completed at least two semesters of study at home university to commencing the exchange period.
√ Non-Chinese citizen.
2.2 Nomination & Application Procedure
A login password to the Online Application Portal has been provided to the exchange coordinators. The nomination link is：http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn/partner/c.asp?action=partner_sign
Exchange coordinators shall
fill in nominees' information
accordingly.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials, it is essential that the
Exchange coordinators
verifies the nominee's information at the time of nomination,
especially the student's first and last names
, which must match exactly as they appear on the passport, as name information cannot be changed later.
Upon successful nomination, students will receive a link to the Online Application Portal via email.
Nominated students should log in to the system and apply before the application deadline. The application guide can click
here
.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials,
students
should confirm that they have completely
filled out all information on the application form
, such as passport number, date of birth, and so on.
Once the application is approved, the students will get the results via email.
2.3 Documents for application
√ Bio-page of passport
*Please ensure your passport is valid for at least 6 months from the commencement of your exchange at SJTU.
√ Resume
√ Latest transcript from the home university
√ A recommendation or nomination letter from the home university
√ Study plan
*There is no fixed template. Students can fill in the courses they are interested in. The application form will be submitted to the school for review. It is recommended that students list courses from the respective school in their study plan. The study plan is for the reference of the reviewing faculty and does not represent the final courses available for selection. Students must be flexible in their course choices, which will be based on the notifications from each school.
√ Passport-size photo
√ Language proficiency certificate (if applicable)
2.4 Application Deadline
Fall (September to January): March 30
Spring (February to June): Oct 30
3. PROGRAMS & COURSES
More than 30 schools/departme
nts at SJTU which are open to university-level exchange students to choose.
Exchange students coming to our university need to be admitted by a specific school. Once admitted,
they can only choose courses from that school
. If they wish to select courses from another school, they must obtain prior approval from the relevant faculty.
Due to limitations in the language of instruction and course capacity at our university, we need the students to be flexible in their course selection.
For the most updated information about majors and courses, please consult with the
School / Department
. Course selection is subject to the school's notification.
3.1 Restricted Programs and Courses
All courses from the
School of Medicine and Shanghai Advanced Institute of Finance
are not available to university-level exchange students.
School of Computer Science and Technology,
The number of vacancies for these courses is highly limited due to the current capacity issue.
The application for
Antai College of Economics and Management
is highly competitive, and applicants must have an academic background in economics and management-related disciplines.
Some schools, such as the
School of International and Public Affairs/KoGuan Law School etc
., do not offer undergraduate courses taught in English.If you choose these schools, you can select the English-taught graduate programs offered by the school.
Not all graduate courses are available to undergraduate exchange students, and vice versa.
3.2 Schools
You can click
here
to view information about each college. The college information will be gradually updated in the modules below.
SJTU Global College
SJTU Global College
offers three engineering majors:
Mechanical Engineering (ME)
,
Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE)
,
Materials Science and Engineering (MSE)
.
Please note that the Joint Institute has its own
Academic Calendar
and
course selection system
.
If you wish to attend courses at the
SJTU Global College
, please select
USJTU Global College
as your first preference in the application form. Details can be found
HERE
. Courses are available for selection
only
by students of this college.
Course selection at the
SJTU Global College
is subject to notifications from the
SJTU Global College
.
SJTU-ParisTech Elite Institute of Technology
SPEIT offers three engineering majors:
Information Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Energy and Power Engineering
. For more detailed information, please visit the
website
.
If you are keen on enrolling in courses at SPEIT, please select
SPEIT
as your first preference in the application form.Courses are available for selection
only
by students of this college.You can find a preliminary course list
HERE
.
School of Humanities-Intensive Chinese Language Program
This program is a
Chinese language learning program
that will provide different levels of Chinese language classes based on your proficiency. The courses include
listening, reading, writing, and speaking
. The classes are held at the
Xuhui campus
.
Please note that the School of Humanities
has its own
course selection system
for the Intensive Chinese Language program.
Course selection for the Internsive Chinese Language Program is subject to notifications from the School of Humanities.
School of Mechanical Engineering
The history of the School of Mechanical Engineering (ME) of Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) dates back to 1913. Over the past century, the school has cultivated tens of thousands of graduates who made significant contributions to technological development and economic growth in the world, such as scientists, engineers, educators, statesmen and entrepreneurs. In the new century, the school adopted a vision of a world-class engineering school that offers the best learning experience for its students, the most rewarding working environment for its faculty and staff as well as the most effective service to the industry and society.
Schedule of
Postgraduate Courses
offered in English for
2025 Fall Semester
https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/innotice/7571.html， for
2026 Spring Semester
https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/innotice/7626.html
The
syllabus for graduate courses
can be found here: https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/coursesInfo.html
Antai College of Economics and Management (ACEM)
There are no major restrictions for
undergraduate exchange students
. Undergraduate exchange students are eligible to choose from all English-taught undergraduate courses offered during the semester. If your Chinese proficiency meets the required level (native speaker proficiency or at least HSK 5 equivalent), you may also select from the available Chinese-taught courses, based on your individual language abilities.
Graduate exchange students
are eligible to select courses from the
Master of International Business (MIB)
program offered during the semester. (This applies only to regular graduate exchange students and does not apply to MBA exchange students, which is operated separately.)
MBA courses are only available for school level MBA exchange students.
More information about courses can be found on https://mba.sjtu.edu.cn/en/academics/academic-calendar.html
Courses are available for selection
only
by students of this college.
School of Materials Science and Engineering (SMSE)
Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) is pioneering in setting up the discipline of Materials Science and Engineering in China, which has been composed of departments of materials science and engineering since 1997 and among which the heat treatment major was set up in 1952. The discipline of 'Materials Science and Engineering' is one of the first national first-degree subjects and has been consistently ranked top 1‰ in ESI. .
Course information can be found here
https://en.smse.sjtu.edu.cn/academics/Courses
School of Agriculture and Biology
School of Agriculture and Biology offers four majors:
Plant Science, Animal Science, Resources and Environment, and Food Science and Engineering
.
School of Agriculture and Biology has been adhering to be a high-level modern agriculture-oriented, actively exploring innovations and demand-driven agricultural science school.
School of Aeronautics and Astronautics
SAA welcomes exchange students to apply for our undergraduate program in
Aeronautics
and
Astronautics Engineering
and graduate program in
Mechanical Engineering
. Detailed course listings for these programs are available on our official website:
https://www.aero.sjtu.edu.cn/en/academics/courses.
School of Life Sciences and Biotechnology
As a leading institution in life sciences and biotechnology education and research, School of Life Sciences and Biotechnology (SLSB) boasts two first-level disciplines, encompassing a wide range of sub-disciplines including
Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Genetics, Microbiology, Developmental Biology, Cell Biology, Bioinformatics, and Bioengineering
. With a vibrant academic community comprising over 200 undergraduates, 300 master's students, and 600 doctoral candidates, SLSB offers a dynamic and collaborative learning environment. Our sub-disciplines in Biology and Biochemistry, Molecular Biology and Genetics rank among the top 1‰ globally in ESI International Rankings, attesting to the excellence of our research and education.
Only English courses at the graduate level are available for selection, and undergraduate exchange students can choose from these courses, which include:Structural Bioinformatics(Spring),Biosafety(Spring),Cell and Developmental Biology(Fall),Genetics and Development(Fall),Microbial Infection and Immunity(Fall),Molecular Signal Transduction(Fall),Synthetic Biology(Fall),Bioprocess Engineering(Fall),Bioprocess and Bioproduct Engineering(Fall),Modern Biotechnology(Fall),Anaerobic Biotechnology and Engineering(Fall)
China-UK Low Carbon College
The Low Carbon College (LCC) is a joint initiative between Shanghai Jiao Tong University and the University of Edinburgh, dedicated to advancing research and education in low-carbon fields. As the first college in China to pioneer low-carbon research and education, LCC offers three master’s programs:
Low Carbon Environment, Low Carbon Energy, and Hydrogen Energy & Energy Storage.
Undergraduate exchange students are also welcome to select courses from these programs. All courses are taught in English.For more details, please visit our website:
https://lcc.sjtu.edu.cn/En
.
School of Media and Communication
The School of Media and Communication boasts a high degree of internationalization, with over 200 international graduate students enrolled throughout the year, hailing from more than 50 countries around the globe, including world-renowned universities.
Our institution is structured into three departments:
Journalism & Communication, Film & Television, and Cultural Industry Management
. Each department offers a range of programs at the bachelor, master, and doctoral levels, catering to diverse academic interests and career aspirations.
In addition to undergraduate and graduate programs in Chinese, we also offer
fully English-taught graduate programs including M.A. in Journalism and Communication
and Ph.D. in Journalism and Communication with a focus on New Media Studies, Exchange students are free to select courses from the corresponding programs for their studies.
School of Biomedical Engineering
BME-SJTU offers four engineering majors:
Biology，Biomedical Engineering，Electrical Engineering，Biology and Medicine
.Please find more information within official website:
https://en.bme.sjtu.edu.cn/
.
If you want to know more information about the courses, please contact
mmxie@sjtu.edu.cn
Global Institute of Future Technology
The institute is named the Global Institute of Future Technology (GIFT), symbolizing a dedicated faculty cultivating gifted individuals with care and vision. GIFT is committed to breaking boundaries in learning, disciplines, and institutions, and to building a globally influential, China-rooted model of industry education integration. Its mission is to nurture strategic, globally minded leaders for future industries. The institute collaborates closely with SJTU’s traditional strengths in science, engineering, biomedical sciences, and management, working to establish large-scale, interdisciplinary research centers, and promoting an innovative model to accelerate technology commercialization.
For more information, please visit our official website:
https://gift.sjtu.edu.cn/en/
Sustainable Energy and Health Science and Technology for the undergraduate study and Graduate programs are targeted at applicants from a variety of disciplines, including Mechanical Engineering, Control Science and Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Design and Automation, Power Engineering, Automation, Mechanics, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology, etc.
All courses taught in GIFT are in English. If you want to know more about courses, please contact with:
kirstenchen@sjtu.edu.cn
4. PREPARATION BEFORE ARRIVAL
All electronic materials, including admission letters and visa forms, will be sent to the student's email address directly. We only provide electronic copies of the admission materials, and the paper version of the admission notice can be collected when the student registers for enrollment.
4.1 Visa application
All students are required to apply for a
Student Visa (X visa)
at the Chinese Embassy or Consulate in your country with their passport, admission notice and visa application for study in China. Please contact the local Embassy or Consulate for more information.
Work permit: NO
4.2 Insurance
All exchange students should purchase the Group Comprehensive Insurance in Mainland China.
Name of the insurance
Comprehensive Insurance & Protection Scheme for Foreigners Staying in China
Company
Ping An Annuity Insurance Company, Ltd.
Website
www.lxbx.net
Premium
400 RMB for a half year, 800 RMB for one year
4.3 Accommodation
Due to the limited number of dormitories, on-campus accommodation is not guaranteed. Accommodation booking notifications will be sent along with the admission materials.
In case of failure to reserve an on-campus room, or if you plan to live off-campus, the average rent for one-room lodging in the campus neighborhood is 3,000 RMB per month for the Minhang Campus and 5,000 RMB per month for the Xuhui Campus.
Both the Xuhui and Minhang campuses provide on-campus accommodation options.
Due to limited capacity, the availability of on-campus accommodation is not guaranteed.
Detailed information on the on-campus accommodation is provided as follows：
About Apartment Buildings for International Students:
Minhang Campus: Building 1 and Building 2 of Nanyang Bei Yuan International Student Apartment
a. Building 1 and Building 2 of Nanyang Bei Yuan (南洋北苑) is located at No. 360, Zhangjiali Road, Minhang District, Shanghai. Two types of rooms are available: a single room with an independent toilet and a single room with a shared toilet. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, and basic furniture. The size of the bed is 120cm*200cm, and bedding needs to be prepared by yourself.
Xuhui Campus:
Tao Li Yuan and Lianxing Building
Tao Li Yuan (桃李苑)
is located on the Xuhui Campus. Two types of rooms are available: single room and double room. Both types are equipped with a private bathroom, an air conditioner, free Wi-Fi, and basic furniture. The size of the bed is 120cm*200cm, and bedding needs to be prepared by yourself.

Graduate Transcript
Graduate transcripts will be produced in batches due to the inconsistent timing of course grade releases, and electronic versions will be sent to students via email. Electronic transcripts for the Fall semester will be sent to the student's email from March to April. For the Spring semester, they will be sent from September to October.
6. SCHOLARSHIP OPPORTUNITIES
For all scholarship students, If your scholarship including the accommodation part，please note
SJTU does not provide free dormitory, but provides accommodation subsidy (1,320 RMB/ Month for General scholars，1,650RMB/Month for Senior scholars)
.
Chinese Government Scholarship
Students applying for CSC Scholarship（Chinese Government Scholarship）should directly contact the local Chinese Embassy or Consulate. For specific application periods and requirements, please refer to the information published by the local Chinese embassy or consulate. China Link Scholarship Program
In order to deepen the academic friendship and mutual understanding between Chinese and foreign young generation, and to build a platform for the international exchanges and cooperation of young talents, China Scholarship Council (CSC) has established the
China Link Scholarship Program
for international students hoping to engage in academic and research activities in China. Please click
HERE
for details.
Please first confirm whether you are from an overseas
partner institution of the China Link Scholarship program
. Eligible students can apply on the CSC website，Please be sure to fill out and complete the CSC form in accordance with the instructions in the Online Application Guide. Please send the CSC application number to
isc.exchange@sjtu.edu.cn
, with the email subject as
China Link + CSC application no + home university
before the deadline list below. Applications from students who do not submit as required will not be considered.
Application Deadline for the CSC System for 2026 Fall incoming exchange student：May 20, 2026
Application Deadline for the CSC System for 2027 Spring incoming exchange student：Nov 20, 2026

績，聯絡電話，e-mail 等相關於申請表上所有資訊。前述個資之處理方式會以 EMAIL
或紙本方式傳遞。 
 
若申請人未提供或所提供之資料錯誤或不完整 ， 將導致國際處無法正確審查申請人之申
請案，造成申請人相關權益之損失如審查不通過等。而申請人依中華民國『個人資料保
護法』得行使相關權利 ： 請求刪除或閱讀，製作複本，停止蒐集，處理，利用。國際
資料傳輸等權利，若申請人欲行使上述權利，請與國際處聯繫。但因行使上述相關權利
而導致申請人權益受損，國際處將不負相關賠償責任。 
 
校內初審錄取後，國際處將提供個人聯絡資料(姓名、性別、系所名稱、年級、手機、
E-mail)予國際處製作通訊錄予同行同學，以互相聯絡行前相關細節。 
 
申請人勾選『我同意』並簽屬本同意書時，即表示已閱讀，瞭解並同意本同意書之所有
內容。 
個資保存五年後(自簽名日期算起)即消毀。

Semester Exchange Program
The Semester Exchange Program attracts students from our partner universities who wish to study at SJTU for one or two semesters. To be an exchange student, candidates must be officially nominated by their home university.​
Program coordinator from partner universities will nominate students in the nomination system. Nominees will receive an application link through which they can complete the online applications.​
Soft reminder: Please do not use Gmail & Hotmail as your nomination and sign-in email. IE and Chrome are recommenced for online application.​
Fact Sheet 2026-2027
1. SEMESTER DATES
FALL Semester
:
September 2026 – January 2027
SPRING Semester
:
February 2027 – July 2027
The
registration date
is generally the Friday before the semester begins.
The
last two weeks
are exam weeks, and the exam schedule will depend on the specific courses.
Please note that the
SJTU Global College
(
UM-SJTU Joint Institute
)
has its own
Academic Calendar
2. NOMINATION & APPLICATION
2.1 Eligibility
√ A minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale.
√ HSK 5 at least for attending the Chinese Taught Course (Original test certificate required).
√ IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 90 for attending English Taught Courses (Original test certificate not required. No requirement for native speakers).
√ Must be a full-time, matriculated student in one of SJTU's exchange partner institutions.
√ Have completed at least two semesters of study at home university to commencing the exchange period.
√ Non-Chinese citizen.
2.2 Nomination & Application Procedure
A login password to the Online Application Portal has been provided to the exchange coordinators. The nomination link is：http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn/partner/c.asp?action=partner_sign
Exchange coordinators shall
fill in nominees' information
accordingly.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials, it is essential that the
Exchange coordinators
verifies the nominee's information at the time of nomination,
especially the student's first and last names
, which must match exactly as they appear on the passport, as name information cannot be changed later.
Upon successful nomination, students will receive a link to the Online Application Portal via email.
Nominated students should log in to the system and apply before the application deadline. The application guide can click
here
.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials,
students
should confirm that they have completely
filled out all information on the application form
, such as passport number, date of birth, and so on.
Once the application is approved, the students will get the results via email.
2.3 Documents for application
√ Bio-page of passport
*Please ensure your passport is valid for at least 6 months from the commencement of your exchange at SJTU.
√ Resume
√ Latest transcript from the home university
√ A recommendation or nomination letter from the home university
√ Study plan
*There is no fixed template. Students can fill in the courses they are interested in. The application form will be submitted to the school for review. It is recommended that students list courses from the respective school in their study plan. The study plan is for the reference of the reviewing faculty and does not represent the final courses available for selection. Students must be flexible in their course choices, which will be based on the notifications from each school.
√ Passport-size photo
√ Language proficiency certificate (if applicable)
2.4 Application Deadline
Fall (September to January): March 30
Spring (February to June): Oct 30
3. PROGRAMS & COURSES
More than 30 schools/departme
nts at SJTU which are open to university-level exchange students to choose.
Exchange students coming to our university need to be admitted by a specific school. Once admitted,
they can only choose courses from that school
. If they wish to select courses from another school, they must obtain prior approval from the relevant faculty.
Due to limitations in the language of instruction and course capacity at our university, we need the students to be flexible in their course selection.
For the most updated information about majors and courses, please consult with the
School / Department
. Course selection is subject to the school's notification.
3.1 Restricted Programs and Courses
All courses from the
School of Medicine and Shanghai Advanced Institute of Finance
are not available to university-level exchange students.
School of Computer Science and Technology,
The number of vacancies for these courses is highly limited due to the current capacity issue.
The application for
Antai College of Economics and Management
is highly competitive, and applicants must have an academic background in economics and management-related disciplines.
Some schools, such as the
School of International and Public Affairs/KoGuan Law School etc
., do not offer undergraduate courses taught in English.If you choose these schools, you can select the English-taught graduate programs offered by the school.
Not all graduate courses are available to undergraduate exchange students, and vice versa.
3.2 Schools
You can click
here
to view information about each college. The college information will be gradually updated in the modules below.
SJTU Global College
SJTU Global College
offers three engineering majors:
Mechanical Engineering (ME)
,
Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE)
,
Materials Science and Engineering (MSE)
.
Please note that the Joint Institute has its own
Academic Calendar
and
course selection system
.
If you wish to attend courses at the
SJTU Global College
, please select
USJTU Global College
as your first preference in the application form. Details can be found
HERE
. Courses are available for selection
only
by students of this college.
Course selection at the
SJTU Global College
is subject to notifications from the
SJTU Global College
.
SJTU-ParisTech Elite Institute of Technology
SPEIT offers three engineering majors:
Information Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Energy and Power Engineering
. For more detailed information, please visit the
website
.
If you are keen on enrolling in courses at SPEIT, please select
SPEIT
as your first preference in the application form.Courses are available for selection
only
by students of this college.You can find a preliminary course list
HERE
.
School of Humanities-Intensive Chinese Language Program
This program is a
Chinese language learning program
that will provide different levels of Chinese language classes based on your proficiency. The courses include
listening, reading, writing, and speaking
. The classes are held at the
Xuhui campus
.
Please note that the School of Humanities
has its own
course selection system
for the Intensive Chinese Language program.
Course selection for the Internsive Chinese Language Program is subject to notifications from the School of Humanities.
School of Mechanical Engineering
The history of the School of Mechanical Engineering (ME) of Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) dates back to 1913. Over the past century, the school has cultivated tens of thousands of graduates who made significant contributions to technological development and economic growth in the world, such as scientists, engineers, educators, statesmen and entrepreneurs. In the new century, the school adopted a vision of a world-class engineering school that offers the best learning experience for its students, the most rewarding working environment for its faculty and staff as well as the most effective service to the industry and society.
Schedule of
Postgraduate Courses
offered in English for
2025 Fall Semester
https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/innotice/7571.html， for
2026 Spring Semester
https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/innotice/7626.html
The
syllabus for graduate courses
can be found here: https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/coursesInfo.html
Antai College of Economics and Management (ACEM)
There are no major restrictions for
undergraduate exchange students
. Undergraduate exchange students are eligible to choose from all English-taught undergraduate courses offered during the semester. If your Chinese proficiency meets the required level (native speaker proficiency or at least HSK 5 equivalent), you may also select from the available Chinese-taught courses, based on your individual language abilities.
Graduate exchange students
are eligible to select courses from the
Master of International Business (MIB)
program offered during the semester. (This applies only to regular graduate exchange students and does not apply to MBA exchange students, which is operated separately.)
MBA courses are only available for school level MBA exchange students.
More information about courses can be found on https://mba.sjtu.edu.cn/en/academics/academic-calendar.html
Courses are available for selection
only
by students of this college.
School of Materials Science and Engineering (SMSE)
Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) is pioneering in setting up the discipline of Materials Science and Engineering in China, which has been composed of departments of materials science and engineering since 1997 and among which the heat treatment major was set up in 1952. The discipline of 'Materials Science and Engineering' is one of the first national first-degree subjects and has been consistently ranked top 1‰ in ESI. .
Course information can be found here
https://en.smse.sjtu.edu.cn/academics/Courses
School of Agriculture and Biology
School of Agriculture and Biology offers four majors:
Plant Science, Animal Science, Resources and Environment, and Food Science and Engineering
.
School of Agriculture and Biology has been adhering to be a high-level modern agriculture-oriented, actively exploring innovations and demand-driven agricultural science school.
School of Aeronautics and Astronautics
SAA welcomes exchange students to apply for our undergraduate program in
Aeronautics
and
Astronautics Engineering
and graduate program in
Mechanical Engineering
. Detailed course listings for these programs are available on our official website:
https://www.aero.sjtu.edu.cn/en/academics/courses.
School of Life Sciences and Biotechnology
As a leading institution in life sciences and biotechnology education and research, School of Life Sciences and Biotechnology (SLSB) boasts two first-level disciplines, encompassing a wide range of sub-disciplines including
Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Genetics, Microbiology, Developmental Biology, Cell Biology, Bioinformatics, and Bioengineering
. With a vibrant academic community comprising over 200 undergraduates, 300 master's students, and 600 doctoral candidates, SLSB offers a dynamic and collaborative learning environment. Our sub-disciplines in Biology and Biochemistry, Molecular Biology and Genetics rank among the top 1‰ globally in ESI International Rankings, attesting to the excellence of our research and education.
Only English courses at the graduate level are available for selection, and undergraduate exchange students can choose from these courses, which include:Structural Bioinformatics(Spring),Biosafety(Spring),Cell and Developmental Biology(Fall),Genetics and Development(Fall),Microbial Infection and Immunity(Fall),Molecular Signal Transduction(Fall),Synthetic Biology(Fall),Bioprocess Engineering(Fall),Bioprocess and Bioproduct Engineering(Fall),Modern Biotechnology(Fall),Anaerobic Biotechnology and Engineering(Fall)
China-UK Low Carbon College
The Low Carbon College (LCC) is a joint initiative between Shanghai Jiao Tong University and the University of Edinburgh, dedicated to advancing research and education in low-carbon fields. As the first college in China to pioneer low-carbon research and education, LCC offers three master’s programs:
Low Carbon Environment, Low Carbon Energy, and Hydrogen Energy & Energy Storage.
Undergraduate exchange students are also welcome to select courses from these programs. All courses are taught in English.For more details, please visit our website:
https://lcc.sjtu.edu.cn/En
.
School of Media and Communication
The School of Media and Communication boasts a high degree of internationalization, with over 200 international graduate students enrolled throughout the year, hailing from more than 50 countries around the globe, including world-renowned universities.
Our institution is structured into three departments:
Journalism & Communication, Film & Television, and Cultural Industry Management
. Each department offers a range of programs at the bachelor, master, and doctoral levels, catering to diverse academic interests and career aspirations.
In addition to undergraduate and graduate programs in Chinese, we also offer
fully English-taught graduate programs including M.A. in Journalism and Communication
and Ph.D. in Journalism and Communication with a focus on New Media Studies, Exchange students are free to select courses from the corresponding programs for their studies.
School of Biomedical Engineering
BME-SJTU offers four engineering majors:
Biology，Biomedical Engineering，Electrical Engineering，Biology and Medicine
.Please find more information within official website:
https://en.bme.sjtu.edu.cn/
.
If you want to know more information about the courses, please contact
mmxie@sjtu.edu.cn
Global Institute of Future Technology
The institute is named the Global Institute of Future Technology (GIFT), symbolizing a dedicated faculty cultivating gifted individuals with care and vision. GIFT is committed to breaking boundaries in learning, disciplines, and institutions, and to building a globally influential, China-rooted model of industry education integration. Its mission is to nurture strategic, globally minded leaders for future industries. The institute collaborates closely with SJTU’s traditional strengths in science, engineering, biomedical sciences, and management, working to establish large-scale, interdisciplinary research centers, and promoting an innovative model to accelerate technology commercialization.
For more information, please visit our official website:
https://gift.sjtu.edu.cn/en/
Sustainable Energy and Health Science and Technology for the undergraduate study and Graduate programs are targeted at applicants from a variety of disciplines, including Mechanical Engineering, Control Science and Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Design and Automation, Power Engineering, Automation, Mechanics, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology, etc.
All courses taught in GIFT are in English. If you want to know more about courses, please contact with:
kirstenchen@sjtu.edu.cn
4. PREPARATION BEFORE ARRIVAL
All electronic materials, including admission letters and visa forms, will be sent to the student's email address directly. We only provide electronic copies of the admission materials, and the paper version of the admission notice can be collected when the student registers for enrollment.
4.1 Visa application
All students are required to apply for a
Student Visa (X visa)
at the Chinese Embassy or Consulate in your country with their passport, admission notice and visa application for study in China. Please contact the local Embassy or Consulate for more information.
Work permit: NO
4.2 Insurance
All exchange students should purchase the Group Comprehensive Insurance in Mainland China.
Name of the insurance
Comprehensive Insurance & Protection Scheme for Foreigners Staying in China
Company
Ping An Annuity Insurance Company, Ltd.
Website
www.lxbx.net
Premium
400 RMB for a half year, 800 RMB for one year
4.3 Accommodation
Due to the limited number of dormitories, on-campus accommodation is not guaranteed. Accommodation booking notifications will be sent along with the admission materials.
In case of failure to reserve an on-campus room, or if you plan to live off-campus, the average rent for one-room lodging in the campus neighborhood is 3,000 RMB per month for the Minhang Campus and 5,000 RMB per month for the Xuhui Campus.
Both the Xuhui and Minhang campuses provide on-campus accommodation options.
Due to limited capacity, the availability of on-campus accommodation is not guaranteed.
Detailed information on the on-campus accommodation is provided as follows：
About Apartment Buildings for International Students:
Minhang Campus: Building 1 and Building 2 of Nanyang Bei Yuan International Student Apartment
a. Building 1 and Building 2 of Nanyang Bei Yuan (南洋北苑) is located at No. 360, Zhangjiali Road, Minhang District, Shanghai. Two types of rooms are available: a single room with an independent toilet and a single room with a shared toilet. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, and basic furniture. The size of the bed is 120cm*200cm, and bedding needs to be prepared by yourself.
Xuhui Campus:
Tao Li Yuan and Lianxing Building
Tao Li Yuan (桃李苑)
is located on the Xuhui Campus. Two types of rooms are available: single room and double room. Both types are equipped with a private bathroom, an air conditioner, free Wi-Fi, and basic furniture. The size of the bed is 120cm*200cm, and bedding needs to be prepared by yourself.

Undergraduate Transcript

Graduate Transcript
Graduate transcripts will be produced in batches due to the inconsistent timing of course grade releases, and electronic versions will be sent to students via email. Electronic transcripts for the Fall semester will be sent to the student's email from March to April. For the Spring semester, they will be sent from September to October.
6. SCHOLARSHIP OPPORTUNITIES
For all scholarship students, If your scholarship including the accommodation part，please note
SJTU does not provide free dormitory, but provides accommodation subsidy (1,320 RMB/ Month for General scholars，1,650RMB/Month for Senior scholars)
.
Chinese Government Scholarship
Students applying for CSC Scholarship（Chinese Government Scholarship）should directly contact the local Chinese Embassy or Consulate. For specific application periods and requirements, please refer to the information published by the local Chinese embassy or consulate. The scholarship content is subject to the website of China Scholarship Council.For Application Guide for Chinese Government Scholarship you can click

China Link Scholarship Program
In order to deepen the academic friendship and mutual understanding between Chinese and foreign young generation, and to build a platform for the international exchanges and cooperation of young talents, China Scholarship Council (CSC) has established the
China Link Scholarship Program
for international students hoping to engage in academic and research activities in China. Please click

partner institution of the China Link Scholarship program
. Eligible students can apply on the CSC website，Please be sure to fill out and complete the CSC form in accordance with the instructions in the Online Application Guide. Please send the CSC application number to

before the deadline list below. Applications from students who do not submit as required will not be considered.

Semester Exchange Program
The Semester Exchange Program attracts students from our partner universities who wish to study at SJTU for one or two semesters. To be an exchange student, candidates must be officially nominated by their home university.​
Program coordinator from partner universities will nominate students in the nomination system. Nominees will receive an application link through which they can complete the online applications.​
Soft reminder: Please do not use Gmail & Hotmail as your nomination and sign-in email. IE and Chrome are recommenced for online application.​
Fact Sheet 2026-2027
1. SEMESTER DATES
FALL Semester
:
September 2026 – January 2027
SPRING Semester
:
February 2027 – July 2027
The
registration date
is generally the Friday before the semester begins.
The
last two weeks
are exam weeks, and the exam schedule will depend on the specific courses.
Please note that the
SJTU Global College
(
UM-SJTU Joint Institute
)
has its own
Academic Calendar
2. NOMINATION & APPLICATION
2.1 Eligibility
√ A minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale.
√ HSK 5 at least for attending the Chinese Taught Course (Original test certificate required).
√ IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 90 for attending English Taught Courses (Original test certificate not required. No requirement for native speakers).
√ Must be a full-time, matriculated student in one of SJTU's exchange partner institutions.
√ Have completed at least two semesters of study at home university to commencing the exchange period.
√ Non-Chinese citizen.
2.2 Nomination & Application Procedure
A login password to the Online Application Portal has been provided to the exchange coordinators. The nomination link is：http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn/partner/c.asp?action=partner_sign
Exchange coordinators shall
fill in nominees' information
accordingly.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials, it is essential that the
Exchange coordinators
verifies the nominee's information at the time of nomination,
especially the student's first and last names
, which must match exactly as they appear on the passport, as name information cannot be changed later.
Upon successful nomination, students will receive a link to the Online Application Portal via email.
Nominated students should log in to the system and apply before the application deadline. The application guide can click
here
.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials,
students
should confirm that they have completely
filled out all information on the application form
, such as passport number, date of birth, and so on.
Once the application is approved, the students will get the results via email.
2.3 Documents for application
√ Bio-page of passport
*Please ensure your passport is valid for at least 6 months from the commencement of your exchange at SJTU.
√ Resume
√ Latest transcript from the home university
√ A recommendation or nomination letter from the home university
√ Study plan
*There is no fixed template. Students can fill in the courses they are interested in. The application form will be submitted to the school for review. It is recommended that students list courses from the respective school in their study plan. The study plan is for the reference of the reviewing faculty and does not represent the final courses available for selection. Students must be flexible in their course choices, which will be based on the notifications from each school.
√ Passport-size photo
√ Language proficiency certificate (if applicable)
2.4 Application Deadline
Fall (September to January): March 30
Spring (February to June): Oct 30
3. PROGRAMS & COURSES
More than 30 schools/departme
nts at SJTU which are open to university-level exchange students to choose.
Exchange students coming to our university need to be admitted by a specific school. Once admitted,
they can only choose courses from that school
. If they wish to select courses from another school, they must obtain prior approval from the relevant faculty.
Due to limitations in the language of instruction and course capacity at our university, we need the students to be flexible in their course selection.
For the most updated information about majors and courses, please consult with the
School / Department
. Course selection is subject to the school's notification.
3.1 Restricted Programs and Courses
All courses from the
School of Medicine and Shanghai Advanced Institute of Finance
are not available to university-level exchange students.
School of Computer Science and Technology,
The number of vacancies for these courses is highly limited due to the current capacity issue.
The application for
Antai College of Economics and Management
is highly competitive, and applicants must have an academic background in economics and management-related disciplines.
Some schools, such as the
School of International and Public Affairs/KoGuan Law School etc
., do not offer undergraduate courses taught in English.If you choose these schools, you can select the English-taught graduate programs offered by the school.
Not all graduate courses are available to undergraduate exchange students, and vice versa.
3.2 Schools
You can click
here
to view information about each college. The college information will be gradually updated in the modules below.
SJTU Global College
SJTU Global College
offers three engineering majors:
Mechanical Engineering (ME)
,
Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE)
,
Materials Science and Engineering (MSE)
.
Please note that the Joint Institute has its own
Academic Calendar
and
course selection system
.
If you wish to attend courses at the
SJTU Global College
, please select
USJTU Global College
as your first preference in the application form. Details can be found
HERE
. Courses are available for selection
only
by students of this college.
Course selection at the
SJTU Global College
is subject to notifications from the
SJTU Global College
.
SJTU-ParisTech Elite Institute of Technology
SPEIT offers three engineering majors:
Information Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Energy and Power Engineering
. For more detailed information, please visit the
website
.
If you are keen on enrolling in courses at SPEIT, please select
SPEIT
as your first preference in the application form.Courses are available for selection
only
by students of this college.You can find a preliminary course list
HERE
.
School of Humanities-Intensive Chinese Language Program
This program is a
Chinese language learning program
that will provide different levels of Chinese language classes based on your proficiency. The courses include
listening, reading, writing, and speaking
. The classes are held at the
Xuhui campus
.
Please note that the School of Humanities
has its own
course selection system
for the Intensive Chinese Language program.
Course selection for the Internsive Chinese Language Program is subject to notifications from the School of Humanities.
School of Mechanical Engineering
The history of the School of Mechanical Engineering (ME) of Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) dates back to 1913. Over the past century, the school has cultivated tens of thousands of graduates who made significant contributions to technological development and economic growth in the world, such as scientists, engineers, educators, statesmen and entrepreneurs. In the new century, the school adopted a vision of a world-class engineering school that offers the best learning experience for its students, the most rewarding working environment for its faculty and staff as well as the most effective service to the industry and society.
Schedule of
Postgraduate Courses
offered in English for
2025 Fall Semester
https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/innotice/7571.html， for
2026 Spring Semester
https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/innotice/7626.html
The
syllabus for graduate courses
can be found here: https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/coursesInfo.html
Antai College of Economics and Management (ACEM)
There are no major restrictions for
undergraduate exchange students
. Undergraduate exchange students are eligible to choose from all English-taught undergraduate courses offered during the semester. If your Chinese proficiency meets the required level (native speaker proficiency or at least HSK 5 equivalent), you may also select from the available Chinese-taught courses, based on your individual language abilities.
Graduate exchange students
are eligible to select courses from the
Master of International Business (MIB)
program offered during the semester. (This applies only to regular graduate exchange students and does not apply to MBA exchange students, which is operated separately.)
MBA courses are only available for school level MBA exchange students.
More information about courses can be found on https://mba.sjtu.edu.cn/en/academics/academic-calendar.html
Courses are available for selection
only
by students of this college.
School of Materials Science and Engineering (SMSE)
Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) is pioneering in setting up the discipline of Materials Science and Engineering in China, which has been composed of departments of materials science and engineering since 1997 and among which the heat treatment major was set up in 1952. The discipline of 'Materials Science and Engineering' is one of the first national first-degree subjects and has been consistently ranked top 1‰ in ESI. .
Course information can be found here
https://en.smse.sjtu.edu.cn/academics/Courses
School of Agriculture and Biology
School of Agriculture and Biology offers four majors:
Plant Science, Animal Science, Resources and Environment, and Food Science and Engineering
.
School of Agriculture and Biology has been adhering to be a high-level modern agriculture-oriented, actively exploring innovations and demand-driven agricultural science school.
School of Aeronautics and Astronautics
SAA welcomes exchange students to apply for our undergraduate program in
Aeronautics
and
Astronautics Engineering
and graduate program in
Mechanical Engineering
. Detailed course listings for these programs are available on our official website:
https://www.aero.sjtu.edu.cn/en/academics/courses.
School of Life Sciences and Biotechnology
As a leading institution in life sciences and biotechnology education and research, School of Life Sciences and Biotechnology (SLSB) boasts two first-level disciplines, encompassing a wide range of sub-disciplines including
Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Genetics, Microbiology, Developmental Biology, Cell Biology, Bioinformatics, and Bioengineering
. With a vibrant academic community comprising over 200 undergraduates, 300 master's students, and 600 doctoral candidates, SLSB offers a dynamic and collaborative learning environment. Our sub-disciplines in Biology and Biochemistry, Molecular Biology and Genetics rank among the top 1‰ globally in ESI International Rankings, attesting to the excellence of our research and education.
Only English courses at the graduate level are available for selection, and undergraduate exchange students can choose from these courses, which include:Structural Bioinformatics(Spring),Biosafety(Spring),Cell and Developmental Biology(Fall),Genetics and Development(Fall),Microbial Infection and Immunity(Fall),Molecular Signal Transduction(Fall),Synthetic Biology(Fall),Bioprocess Engineering(Fall),Bioprocess and Bioproduct Engineering(Fall),Modern Biotechnology(Fall),Anaerobic Biotechnology and Engineering(Fall)
China-UK Low Carbon College
The Low Carbon College (LCC) is a joint initiative between Shanghai Jiao Tong University and the University of Edinburgh, dedicated to advancing research and education in low-carbon fields. As the first college in China to pioneer low-carbon research and education, LCC offers three master’s programs:
Low Carbon Environment, Low Carbon Energy, and Hydrogen Energy & Energy Storage.
Undergraduate exchange students are also welcome to select courses from these programs. All courses are taught in English.For more details, please visit our website:
https://lcc.sjtu.edu.cn/En
.
School of Media and Communication
The School of Media and Communication boasts a high degree of internationalization, with over 200 international graduate students enrolled throughout the year, hailing from more than 50 countries around the globe, including world-renowned universities.
Our institution is structured into three departments:
Journalism & Communication, Film & Television, and Cultural Industry Management
. Each department offers a range of programs at the bachelor, master, and doctoral levels, catering to diverse academic interests and career aspirations.
In addition to undergraduate and graduate programs in Chinese, we also offer
fully English-taught graduate programs including M.A. in Journalism and Communication
and Ph.D. in Journalism and Communication with a focus on New Media Studies, Exchange students are free to select courses from the corresponding programs for their studies.
School of Biomedical Engineering
BME-SJTU offers four engineering majors:
Biology，Biomedical Engineering，Electrical Engineering，Biology and Medicine
.Please find more information within official website:
https://en.bme.sjtu.edu.cn/
.
If you want to know more information about the courses, please contact
mmxie@sjtu.edu.cn
Global Institute of Future Technology
The institute is named the Global Institute of Future Technology (GIFT), symbolizing a dedicated faculty cultivating gifted individuals with care and vision. GIFT is committed to breaking boundaries in learning, disciplines, and institutions, and to building a globally influential, China-rooted model of industry education integration. Its mission is to nurture strategic, globally minded leaders for future industries. The institute collaborates closely with SJTU’s traditional strengths in science, engineering, biomedical sciences, and management, working to establish large-scale, interdisciplinary research centers, and promoting an innovative model to accelerate technology commercialization.
For more information, please visit our official website:
https://gift.sjtu.edu.cn/en/
Sustainable Energy and Health Science and Technology for the undergraduate study and Graduate programs are targeted at applicants from a variety of disciplines, including Mechanical Engineering, Control Science and Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Design and Automation, Power Engineering, Automation, Mechanics, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology, etc.
All courses taught in GIFT are in English. If you want to know more about courses, please contact with:
kirstenchen@sjtu.edu.cn
4. PREPARATION BEFORE ARRIVAL
All electronic materials, including admission letters and visa forms, will be sent to the student's email address directly. We only provide electronic copies of the admission materials, and the paper version of the admission notice can be collected when the student registers for enrollment.
4.1 Visa application
All students are required to apply for a
Student Visa (X visa)
at the Chinese Embassy or Consulate in your country with their passport, admission notice and visa application for study in China. Please contact the local Embassy or Consulate for more information.
Work permit: NO
4.2 Insurance
All exchange students should purchase the Group Comprehensive Insurance in Mainland China.
Name of the insurance
Comprehensive Insurance & Protection Scheme for Foreigners Staying in China
Company
Ping An Annuity Insurance Company, Ltd.
Website
www.lxbx.net
Premium
400 RMB for a half year, 800 RMB for one year
4.3 Accommodation
Due to the limited number of dormitories, on-campus accommodation is not guaranteed. Accommodation booking notifications will be sent along with the admission materials.
In case of failure to reserve an on-campus room, or if you plan to live off-campus, the average rent for one-room lodging in the campus neighborhood is 3,000 RMB per month for the Minhang Campus and 5,000 RMB per month for the Xuhui Campus.
Both the Xuhui and Minhang campuses provide on-campus accommodation options.
Due to limited capacity, the availability of on-campus accommodation is not guaranteed.
Detailed information on the on-campus accommodation is provided as follows：
About Apartment Buildings for International Students:
Minhang Campus: Building 1 and Building 2 of Nanyang Bei Yuan International Student Apartment
a. Building 1 and Building 2 of Nanyang Bei Yuan (南洋北苑) is located at No. 360, Zhangjiali Road, Minhang District, Shanghai. Two types of rooms are available: a single room with an independent toilet and a single room with a shared toilet. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, and basic furniture. The size of the bed is 120cm*200cm, and bedding needs to be prepared by yourself.
Xuhui Campus:
Tao Li Yuan and Lianxing Building
Tao Li Yuan (桃李苑)
is located on the Xuhui Campus. Two types of rooms are available: single room and double room. Both types are equipped with a private bathroom, an air conditioner, free Wi-Fi, and basic furniture. The size of the bed is 120cm*200cm, and bedding needs to be prepared by yourself.

4.4 Estimated Costs
The average cost of living: 4,000RMB/month
Food: 2,000 RMB /month at university canteen
Health insurance: 400 RMB for half year, 800 RMB for one year
5. ACADEMIC TRANSCRIPTS
Undergraduate Transcript
Undergraduate transcripts can be downloaded by logging into the system at log into the
“交我办” or
my.sjtu.edu.cn
---
undergraduate
---
undergraduate Electronic Transcript
to apply for the transcript.
Graduate Transcript
Graduate transcripts will be produced in batches due to the inconsistent timing of course grade releases, and electronic versions will be sent to students via email. Electronic transcripts for the Fall semester will be sent to the student's email from March to April. For the Spring semester, they will be sent from September to October.
6. SCHOLARSHIP OPPORTUNITIES
For all scholarship students, If your scholarship including the accommodation part，please note
SJTU does not provide free dormitory, but provides accommodation subsidy (1,320 RMB/ Month for General scholars，1,650RMB/Month for Senior scholars)
.
Chinese Government Scholarship
Students applying for CSC Scholarship（Chinese Government Scholarship）should directly contact the local Chinese Embassy or Consulate. For specific application periods and requirements, please refer to the information published by the local Chinese embassy or consulate. The scholarship content is subject to the website of China Scholarship Council.For Application Guide for Chinese Government Scholarship you can click
HERE
.
China Link Scholarship Program
In order to deepen the academic friendship and mutual understanding between Chinese and foreign young generation, and to build a platform for the international exchanges and cooperation of young talents, China Scholarship Council (CSC) has established the
China Link Scholarship Program
for international students hoping to engage in academic and research activities in China. Please click
HERE
for details.
Please first confirm whether you are from an overseas
partner institution of the China Link Scholarship program
. Eligible students can apply on the CSC website，Please be sure to fill out and complete the CSC form in accordance with the instructions in the Online Application Guide. Please send the CSC application number to
isc.exchange@sjtu.edu.cn
, with the email subject as
China Link + CSC application no + home university
before the deadline list below. Applications from students who do not submit as required will not be considered.
Application Deadline for the CSC System for 2026 Fall incoming exchange student：May 20, 2026
Application Deadline for the CSC System for 2027 Spring incoming exchange student：Nov 20, 2026
7. LIFE IN SHANGHAI
Information about life in Shanghai/China, including WIFI & SIM cards, payment methods, tours & experience, transportation and other relevant information is available at “
Living in Shanghai
”.
Shanghai International Services - A guide to Shanghai for Expats

Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Genetics, Microbiology, Developmental Biology, Cell Biology, Bioinformatics, and Bioengineering

China-UK Low Carbon College

Low Carbon Environment, Low Carbon Energy, and Hydrogen Energy & Energy Storage.
